name: linux-main-ci

evidence: Main Full check job 139905472453 (928c88cc3d): rehearsal duplicate --port expected exit 1 got 2; verify-cutover exit 2 'Unable to read SQLite snapshot'. Job 139921185581 (4bb678a83e): shared-workspace-registry showUnit test timed out at 60000ms. Both e2e failures reproduced in a node:24 + bun 1.2.18 Linux container.

Tests existed but sessions verify on macOS, where Apple SQLite always parses file: URIs and the OS ephemeral range (49152-65535) equals the accepted --port range; Linux Full check was the only Linux run and PRs merged while it was red or queued. The rehearsal helper never asserted the assigned port is acceptable to --port, so the cause surfaced as an unexplained exit 2; it now asserts the range. The registry test shared a 60s budget between two full repository indexes.
